Class KeyedSkin

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.client.KeyedSkin
public final class KeyedSkin extends Object
While the agent is running, the opponent is drawn with a flat two-colour skin (blue head, green body) and without anything that would cover or tint it. In the arena that is every other player; in a fight on a server it is only the one being fought. This only changes what this client renders; the other player's real skin, armour and health are untouched.

The player need not look at that figure: with setTwoPass(boolean) the keyed picture is drawn in a pass of its own, for the agent only, and the screen gets the world as it really looks.
